registeredUse.allowedClaim: Development benchmark for known synthetic capture corruptions on concrete image patches from this source.
prohibitedClaims: damage severity, structural safety, habitability, or triage
registeredUse.purpose: Train and compare a deterministic baseline and a tiny capture-quality model using synthetic corruptions only.

upstream.citation: Ozgenel, C. F. (2019). Concrete Crack Images for Classification, version 2.

knownLimitations: The images are concrete patches, not post-earthquake field inspection photographs.
The source has crack/no-crack labels, not human capture-quality labels.
Synthetic corruptions do not establish real-camera acceptability thresholds.
The upstream corpus was cropped from 458 high-resolution photographs, but this mirror does not expose a parent photograph identifier.
Perceptual deduplication reduces obvious leakage but cannot prove parent-scene independence.
